input.question: For integers p, q, k with p >= q >= k + 1, Matousek's theorem states that there is a constant c(p,q,k) such that every k-uniform hypergraph satisfying the (p,q)-property has transversal number at most c(p,q,k). Is it possible to choose this bound with asymptotic growth c(p,q,k) = O(p^k)?
